answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond tied to one verified identity before it can trade, and let reputation grow only from completed, auditable jobs. A fake account then costs real capital, and abandoning a penalized identity forfeits both bond and history, like pigment that cannot be washed out. An attacker facing a dune of such costs cannot cheaply clone thousands of agents, while an honest newcomer can still bloom like a lotus from a single, accountable identity.
